**Finding: deviation (high severity) — Section 2.2**

Section 2.2 obliges Meridian to use Copperleaf as its "sole and exclusive provider of hosted analytics services throughout the term" — an unlimited-duration, performance-free exclusive dealing commitment, which is the playbook's walk-away position. It also contradicts Section 12.3, where Copperleaf acknowledges we have made no exclusivity commitment.

Redline (validated, ok:true): delete paragraph 2.2 in full, relying on Section 12.3's non-exclusivity acknowledgement. The comment offers the fallback (category-limited, 12-month exclusivity ending automatically on any SLA or delivery failure) if Copperleaf needs volume comfort. No other exclusivity language burdens us — the remaining "exclusive" references relate to remedies and jurisdiction.
